patterns.note: Alternating full-width sections with distinct background colors (off-white, light green, dark green) to segment content visually.
Content blocks frequently use a two-column layout, pairing large, impactful text with custom 3D illustrations or photography.
A strong, limited color palette primarily uses two shades of green (dark and light) and an off-white background, with a bright accent green for calls to action.
The primary navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
Prominent integration of custom, friendly 3D character illustrations and high-quality photography directly within content sections to enhance brand personality.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that maintains the primary navigation and brand logo visible at the top of the screen during scrolling.
Content sections are visually delineated by full-width background color changes and generous vertical spacing, often containing card-like elements with consistently rounded corners.
Calls to action and key interactive elements are highlighted using a vibrant accent green, providing clear visual cues for user engagement.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) create strong visual hierarchy, complemented by clear, readable body text and smaller, uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Rounded corners are consistently applied to buttons, cards, and section containers, giving a soft and approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density overall, with an airy hero section and generous vertical padding between content blocks, creating a comfortable reading rhythm.

standout: The site's distinctive use of custom, friendly 3D character illustrations (like the bear and the phone with cards) combined with a bold, two-tone green color palette creates a unique and approachable brand identity that stands out from typical financial services sites.
